2608.14138.title: SPARGen: Unifying Spatial Perception and Reasoning through Native Multimodal Generation
2608.14138.paper_summary: Spatial perception and reasoning from visual observations require recovering geometric structure, establishing correspondences, and understanding spatial relations. Existing approaches typically address these capabilities separately using task-specific architectures or external geometric modules, limiting knowledge transfer among complementary representations of the same physical scene. We introduce SPARGen, a unified multimodal framework that casts 3D reconstruction, dense correspondence, and spatial reasoning as instruction-conditioned generation tasks. SPARGen serializes compact structured and linguistic outputs as token sequences while generating dense geometric fields in image-aligned forms, enabling spatial supervision to jointly shape shared representations within a native multimodal generative model. Experiments across benchmarks for 3D reconstruction, correspondence, and spatial reasoning show that SPARGen achieves competitive performance across heterogeneous spatial tasks within a single native multimodal generative framework.
2608.14138.paper_summary_zh: 空間感知和基於視覺觀察的推理需要恢復幾何結構、建立對應關係和理解空間關係。現有的方法通常分開處理這些能力，使用特定任務的架構或外部幾何模塊，限制了同一物理場景的互補表示之間的知識轉移。我們介紹了SPARGen，一個統一的多模態框架，將3D重建、密集對應和空間推理視為基於指令的生成任務。SPARGen將緊湊的結構化和語言輸出序列化為標記序列，同時以圖像對齊的形式生成密集的幾何場，從而使空間監督能夠共同塑造原生多模態生成模型中的共享表示。在3D重建、對應和空間推理的基準測試中進行的實驗顯示，SPARGen在單一原生多模態生成框架內，在異質空間任務中實現了具有競爭力的性能。
